letter_opening: I am applying for the Program Coordinator role you posted for Sampletown Community Center. The posting reads like a summary of my last four years: schedules that hold together, volunteers who stay, and records that are ready before anyone asks.
letter_body: At the Sampletown Housing Council, I coordinate 40 volunteers a week across three sites and prepare the monthly summary our board uses to make decisions. Before that, I ran a front desk that greeted more than 100 people a day. Three details from that work line up with what your posting asks for:
letter_bullets: A weekly schedule of 40 volunteers across three buildings, kept accurate since 2022.
A shared intake log that cut application processing time roughly in half.
Short, plain-English summaries that coworkers and board members actually read.
letter_closing: If any part of this looks like a fit, I would be glad to talk by phone or stop by the Center. My résumé and reference sheet are attached. Thank you for your time.
ref_note: These references have agreed to speak about my work. A short email first is the easiest way to set up a time.
